premises.text: Medication adherence means patients taking the right pill at the right time and is a major healthcare cost and outcomes problem
premises.evidence_span: medication adherence, which basically means patients taking the right pill at the right time

premises.text: The smart bottle sends open/close timestamps and amount removed to the cloud and compares usage to the prescribed schedule
premises.evidence_span: it sends two pieces of data into the cloud. Number one, a timestamp of the open and close of the cap. And number two, a measurement of the amount of medication removed

premises.text: Missed doses trigger on-bottle lights/chimes and automated phone or text alerts, optionally to caregivers
premises.evidence_span: we have on-bottle lights and chimes, and we also have phone or text message alerts as well

premises.text: Built-in cellular (CDMA) and normal-bottle UX mean no Wi-Fi/Bluetooth sync or apps; it works from the pharmacy with multi-week battery life
premises.evidence_span: patients don't have to sync it to Wi-Fi or Bluetooth. It simply works the moment they get it from the pharmacy

premises.text: An open API integrates with healthcare partners, and missed-dose feedback enables real-time care alerts beyond reminders
premises.evidence_span: We've built this solution with an open API so we can easily integrate with all of our health care partners

premises.text: Specialty pharma partners distribute high-cost drugs in the bottle; patients get it free and pharma pays for increased adherence and refills
premises.evidence_span: partner with specialty pharma companies to distribute high-cost drugs in our bottle

value.text: Improve medication adherence and patient engagement
value.evidence_span: improve medication adherence and patient engagement

causal_links.evidence_span: improve medication adherence and patient engagement
we're the easiest to set up and the easiest to use
AdhereTech will increase adherence. refills, and ultimately revenues for the pharma company
